PayReceive.description:
Direction for instrument legs (universal for IRS, CDS, variance swaps, etc.)

For interest rate swaps: Pay = pay fixed/receive floating, Receive = receive fixed/pay floating
For credit default swaps: Pay = buy protection (pay premium), Receive = sell protection (receive premium)
For variance swaps: Pay = short variance, Receive = long variance

oneOf.description: Pay the primary leg (fixed rate in IRS, protection premium in CDS, short variance)
Receive the primary leg (fixed rate in IRS, protection premium in CDS, long variance)

description: Identifier, notional, side, fixed rate, dates, rate index and curves of a vanilla swap built from market conventions.

fixed_rate.description: Fixed coupon rate (as a decimal, e.g. 0.03 = 3%).

index_id.description: Rate index identifier used to resolve conventions (e.g. `"USD-SOFR"`).

notional.description: Notional principal amount; its currency is the payment currency.
